<?php
/**
 * CloudTenant SDK - Multi-tenant Resource Orchestrator
 * Handles cross-tenant resource delegation and execution contexts
 */

namespace CloudInfra\SDK;

class TenantContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private array $permissions;
    private string $executionScope;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId, array $permissions) {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->permissions = $permissions;
        $this->executionScope = 'restricted';
    }
    
    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getPermissions(): array { return $this->permissions; }
    public function getScope(): string { return $this->executionScope; }
}

class ResourceChain {
    private array $handlers = [];
    private array $metadata = [];
    
    public function addHandler(callable $handler, array $meta = []): self {
        $this->handlers[] = $handler;
        $this->metadata[] = $meta;
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function getHandlers(): array { return $this->handlers; }
    public function getMetadata(): array { return $this->metadata; }
}

class ExecutionPipeline {
    private TenantContext $context;
    private array $gadgetRegistry = [];
    
    public function __construct(TenantContext $context) {
        $this->context = $context;
    }
    
    public function registerGadget(string $name, callable $impl): void {
        $this->gadgetRegistry[$name] = $impl;
    }
    
    public function resolveChain(ResourceChain $chain): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($chain->getHandlers() as $idx => $handler) {
            $meta = $chain->getMetadata()[$idx] ?? [];
            $results[] = $this->executeInContext($handler, $meta);
        }
        return $results;
    }
    
    private function executeInContext(callable $handler, array $meta): mixed {
        $tenantId = $this->context->getTenantId();
        $scope = $meta['scope'] ?? $this->context->getScope();
        
        // Validate tenant isolation boundary
        if (!$this->validateIsolation($tenantId, $scope)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Tenant isolation violation');
        }
        
        return $handler($this->context, $meta);
    }
    
    private function validateIsolation(string $tenantId, string $scope): bool {
        // Restricted scope always passes for own tenant
        if ($scope === 'restricted') {
            return true;
        }
        // Elevated scope requires explicit permission
        if ($scope === 'elevated') {
            return in_array('cross_tenant', $this->context->getPermissions());
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class DelegationManager {
    private array $delegations = [];
    
    public function createDelegation(string $fromTenant, string $toTenant, array $resources): string {
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->delegations[$token] = [
            'from' => $fromTenant,
            'to' => $toTenant,
            'resources' => $resources,
            'created' => time(),
            'used' => false
        ];
        return $token;
    }
    
    public function consumeDelegation(string $token, string $requestingTenant): array {
        if (!isset($this->delegations[$token])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid delegation token');
        }
        
        $delegation = $this->delegations[$token];
        
        if ($delegation['to'] !== $requestingTenant) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Delegation not authorized for this tenant');
        }
        
        if ($delegation['used']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Delegation already consumed');
        }
        
        $this->delegations[$token]['used'] = true;
        return $delegation['resources'];
    }
}

class ResourceSerializer {
    /**
     * Deserializes a resource descriptor from the delegation payload.
     * Uses a controlled allowlist approach for type resolution.
     */
    public function deserializeDescriptor(string $payload, TenantContext $context): object {
        $allowedClasses = $this->getAllowedClasses($context);
        // Reconstruct object from serialized delegation descriptor
        $obj = unserialize($payload, ['allowed_classes' => $allowedClasses]);
        if ($obj === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Deserialization failed');
        }
        return $obj;
    }
    
    private function getAllowedClasses(TenantContext $context): array|bool {
        $base = [ResourceDescriptor::class, ResourceMetadata::class];
        
        // If tenant has elevated permissions, allow extended class set
        // This enables cross-tenant resource type sharing
        if (in_array('resource_sharing', $context->getPermissions())) {
            return true; // Allow all classes for resource sharing tenants
        }
        
        return $base;
    }
}

class ResourceDescriptor {
    public string $type;
    public string $id;
    public array $attributes;
    
    public function __construct(string $type, string $id, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
    }
}

class ResourceMetadata {
    public string $owner;
    public int $created;
    public array $tags;
    
    public function __construct(string $owner, int $created, array $tags = []) {
        $this->owner = $owner;
        $this->created = $created;
        $this->tags = $tags;
    }
}

// Main orchestration entry point
class CloudOrchestrator {
    private ExecutionPipeline $pipeline;
    private DelegationManager $delegationMgr;
    private ResourceSerializer $serializer;
    
    public function __construct(TenantContext $context) {
        $this->pipeline = new ExecutionPipeline($context);
        $this->delegationMgr = new DelegationManager();
        $this->serializer = new ResourceSerializer();
    }
    
    public function processDelegatedResource(string $token, string $serializedDescriptor, TenantContext $context): object {
        // First validate the delegation
        $resources = $this->delegationMgr->consumeDelegation($token, $context->getTenantId());
        
        // Then deserialize the resource descriptor from the delegating tenant
        $descriptor = $this->serializer->deserializeDescriptor($serializedDescriptor, $context);
        
        return $descriptor;
    }
}
